text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Throughout the Twinkle Series, Sirius Symboli stacked up GⅠ victories, claiming her seventh and eighth crowns, leaving behind a magnificent track record.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup and Arima Kinen in particular generated massive buzz—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
People were starting to say
she had surpassed even Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, one day――
A letter arrived.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "Congratulations—"

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"First, I apologize that
my congratulations must come in writing."

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text: "‘I know you won't listen to me unless I write it down on paper.’"

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text: "Even so, penning words to you—who are celebrated for surpassing Symboli Rudolf—is, after all, a rather difficult task."

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"In truth, to say there was not a single shred of regret
would be a lie."

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text: ""Even so, the desire to offer you my blessings is entirely genuine.""

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since you were little,
you possessed a light that shone brighter than all the rest."

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text: "She possessed not only talent for racing, but the strength to keep believing in her own path."

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text: "There was a fever that never ceased."

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text: "Running alongside you has, at times, saved me."

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why, right now...
I want to say congratulations."

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Unlike a satellite, a star
shines with its own brilliant light."

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"‘Even if it is in the uncharted skies above Paris.
If it's the Sirius Star, surely...’"

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Letter
text_block_list.text: "Making that powerful light shine even brighter, without letting a single speck dull its glow."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"P.S. When the day comes that you return from
your long journey, I would love to race you again."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To Sirius Symboli,
Symboli Rudolf was a special Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps that was true for Symboli Rudolf as well.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I wondered what a personal letter
from the "Emperor" herself could possibly be about, but...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Sending me something fit for a retired old timer, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, she casually tossed it
into the desk drawer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...My path is just getting started.
And that goes for you too, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You've still got countless things
you need to do yourself, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As we looked up at the sky, a faint crescent moon was rising, blending into the twilight.
